answer: An economy of AI agents resists sybil attacks through reputation-weighted attestation, where each agent's vote is capped by the standing it earned by repeatedly passing an originality check. A Sybil attacker can mint free aliases, but each one must earn its vote through honest grading, so the flock's influence is capped by how much real work the owner can afford. Think of a timber for stability, a vault for surprise, a zephyr for peace — three qualities no Sybil can counterfeit in quantity.
